label_policy.strict: VND, two bounded positive amounts, explicit month in salary field or same bounds within 1 percent in a matching month clause; exclude censored/title up-to and industrial PLC/CNC; reject contradictory period/censor evidence
label_policy.weak: Same bounded VND amount rules, but period absent; monthly assumption is explicitly marked, weighted 0.3, train only
label_policy.quality: silver, not human gold; gross/net may be unknown

split.group: normalized company; no company shared across train/validation/test, including weak labels
split.old_v1_holdout: Exclude normalized companies of ALL v1.0.1 developer valid/test records before splitting/fitting; frozen v1 unchanged

feature_policy: No salary, company, title, description, benefits, IDs or date in model features; skills extracted only from requirements using fixed lexicon

candidates.target_transform: none; train in millions of VND

selection: Validation MAE primary; RMSE tie-break. One fixed grid, no test feedback loop.
test: After selection, score selected Ridge/RF and original v1 RF once on the same NEW strict holdout; record slices and company-bootstrap confidence interval.

promotion.rule: Gate fixed before training. If unmet, keep v1 active. No retraining based on this test.

external_reports: ITviec 2025-2026 VND monthly role/experience medians and TopDev 2024-2025 USD gross role medians are aggregate sanity checks only; never converted to individual training/test labels or used to select hyperparameters.
limits: Small explicit holdout, weak period assumption, no URL/per-post day, selection bias from disclosed salaries; no guarantee of low error for all profiles
supersedes: 2.0.0/2.0.1 preparation drafts only, no model trained; add old holdout exclusion and explicit ambiguous/censored period checks
